newsitem.title: USA: Calif. receives $60 mln in funding for prisons.
newsitem.headline: Calif. receives $60 mln in funding for prisons.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson said Thursday the Department of Justice released more than $60 million in prison construction funding to the state.
The Department of Justice released the funds under the federal violent offender incarceration and truth-in-sentencing incentive grant programs, Wilson said in a statement.

"As California's prison population continues to increase due to the passage of the 'Three Strikes, You're Out' law and the state's own comprehensive truth-in-sentencing law, this money will be a critical source of funding for prison construction," Wilson said.
